posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina shares heartwarming May photo dump featuring baby Vihaan's tiny hands, Vicky Kaushal's birthday picnic, and her quest for the best hot chocolate.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit announces historic Wembley Stadium show on Sept 12 — first South Asian artist ever. AURA Tour rocking Toronto, Main Vaapas Aaunga hits theatres June 12.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alpha release preponed to July 3 as YRF shuffles Spy Universe slate. Bobby Deol quashes on-set rift rumors, calls Alia 'very professional.'

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka confirms six months of shoot remaining for Rajamouli's ₹1,300 Cr epic Varanasi with Mahesh Babu — Antarctica schedule reportedly on the cards.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's new Cadillac Escalade goes viral online. King shoot underway with Suhana Khan and Abhishek Bachchan — Christmas 2026 release confirmed.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena wraps Meghna Gulzar's Daayra with Prithviraj Sukumaran. In advanced talks to reunite with Salman Khan for Raj & DK's superhero film.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha in talks to star opposite Vicky Kaushal in Maddock's mythological epic Mahavatar. Also prepping for a period musical drama with Laxman Utekar.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika confirmed for Atlee's Raaka with Allu Arjun. At Stockholm's Cartier event, she hints at standing by her decision to exit Sandeep Reddy Vanga's Spirit.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Dhurandhar 2 arrives on JioHotstar June 4 after a massive ₹1,800 Cr worldwide box office run. Next film Pralay, a post-apocalyptic thriller, begins shooting in August.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Madhuri Dixit defends Aishwarya against body-shaming trolls after Cannes 2026: 'You cannot reduce her to a number.' Her 24th Cannes appearance stunned in swan-inspired couture.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika shoots her boldest role yet — playing the main villain in Atlee's Raaka opposite Allu Arjun and Deepika. Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor hits June 19.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha headlines Maa Inti Bangaram, a family empowerment drama releasing June 19 in Telugu. Also in the pipeline: Maddock's horror-comedy with Ayushmann Khurrana.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's Raaka with Atlee shapes up as a massive VFX sci-fi spectacle — multiple roles, half-human half-animal avatar. Deepika, Rashmika, and Janhvi round out the cast.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports action epic Peddi hits theatres June 4 with Janhvi Kapoor. His MMA-fighter bodyguard Kevin Kunta is going viral during promotions.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Dragon with KGF director Prashanth Neel pushed to June 2027 for a larger global rollout. War 2 with Hrithik Roshan builds massive hype for August 14 release.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi's Pan-India debut Peddi with Ram Charan arrives June 4 — a sports action drama set in a rustic backdrop. Also part of Atlee's star-studded Raaka cast.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya turns 27 with star-studded birthday wishes from Suhana Khan and Kareena. Named a summer hairstyle trendsetter alongside Priyanka and Shraddha.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara opens up about shooting Toxic in Kannada with Yash — 'mugging up dialogues the night before.' Also shares how motherhood has transformed her perspective.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: War 2 with Jr NTR crosses 500K interest on BookMyShow ahead of August 14 release. Krrish 4 confirmed with Hrithik making his directorial debut.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai hits theatres June 5 — Varun reunites with dad David Dhawan for a classic rom-com with Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya drops 'Siddha Bhajo' on June 1 — her father's favorite song. The Unstoppable Tour heads to Australia and 10+ US cities this summer, all sold out.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman reunites with Imtiaz Ali and Irshad Kamil for Main Vaapas Aaunga (June 12) — the celebrated trio behind Rockstar and Tamasha delivers a new soul-stirring soundtrack.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's final film Jana Nayagan eyes a July release after Tamil Nadu election delays. The ₹500 Cr+ magnum opus marks his grand farewell to cinema.
